column1: # Each kernel crate's seconds in a release suite part, building and running its own tests (its
# library's unit tests, binaries and test targets) with overflow checks and debug assertions on, on
# the slowest native leg, macOS x86-64 (four threads): its test units' build seconds from a cargo
# `--timings` report of the whole release suite on a development machine (four threads; 26.4
# minutes there against the runner's 33.6), times 1.27, plus its tests' run seconds summed from the
# two release suite parts of main's push run 44000736713 on 79dd48d74, the sum over four threads,
# at least 1. The libraries a part builds for every crate (about four minutes) and its set-up are
# the same in every part and are not counted. `geom_test::test_scope::Selection::parts` balances
# `kernel.yml`'s release suite shares by them (`kernel-quality test-scope --parts`); a crate not
# listed is planned at the slowest listed time.
